revision.text: Graph theory studies [[Graph (discrete mathematics)|graphs]]. It underpins [[Network science]] and the analysis of a [[Social network]]. [[Category:Mathematics]]
Network science applies [[Graph theory]] to real systems such as a [[Social network]]. [[Category:Mathematics]] [[Category:Systems science]]
A social network is a structure studied with [[Graph theory]] and [[Network science]]. [[Category:Sociology]]
A graph is the core object of [[Graph theory]]. [[Category:Mathematics]]
